name: fixture-factory
description: /fixtures generates realistic test data that matches your schema or types.

count.title: Default count
count.description: Records generated when /fixtures gets no count (at most 200).

outputDir.title: Fixtures folder
outputDir.description: Folder Save writes to, relative to the project. Empty: tests/fixtures, test/fixtures, __fixtures__ or spec/fixtures when one exists, else fixtures/.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model that writes the records: an alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or a full model id.
